messages:
sam lee: FYI seeing a weird drain/rebind/evict loop in ap-southeast1-b since ~07:25. Small gpu pods reschedule to same rack, conntrack spikes, then kubelet starts evicting due to 'node pressure' churn.
priya n.: can you paste the node logs?
sam lee: sure — here's the relevant tail from kube-proxy and kubelet on node-rack12-3:
```
Jul 17 07:25:12 kube-proxy[1]: conntrack: table full, dropping packet
Jul 17 07:25:13 kubelet[1]: Eviction threshold met: imagefs.available < threshold
Jul 17 07:25:14 network-driver: FIN_WAIT accumulation: 91%
```
alex g.: hmm FIN_WAIT accumulation + conntrack table full screams conntrack limit. Are pods opening lots of short-lived connections during warm attach?
priya n.: which workloads are bouncing? any common image or sidecar?
sam lee: tiny inference jobs (batch size 1) + a logging sidecar that proxies telemetry to central collector. They all land on the same rack because of recent rebalancer changes.
maria ops: ops-bot flagged NIC firmware flaps earlier this morning on that rack. packet drops -> sockets in weird states -> conntrack blowup.
ops-bot: alert: conntrack_count > 95% on nodes [node-rack12-3, node-rack12-4] at 07:24:58; nic-flap events correlated (firmware v1.2.7).
alex g.: two-pronged mitigation: 1) throttle scheduler packing to avoid concentrating tiny pods on same rack; 2) bump nf_conntrack_max temporarily + clear conntrack on urgent nodes.
priya n.: agree. we should also taint the rack nodes with 'network-unhealthy=true:NoSchedule' while we remediate so new pods don't keep landing.
sam lee: I'm going to cordon node-rack12-3 and apply taint. also running `conntrack -F` on the worst-off node now (careful, will drop active flows).
sam lee: ran `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` and `conntrack -F` on node-rack12-3 and 12-4, evictions stopped for now.
priya n.: can we avoid manual clears by increasing nf_conntrack hashsize + bump kube-proxy conntrack settings cluster-side? open infra change?
alex g.: create a short-lived scheduler override: reduce binpack score on that rack (nodeAffinity weight down) until we finish firmware roll. I'll push a gate in the scheduler config for ap-southeast1-b.
maria ops: rolling fw upgrade scheduled for rack12 at 02:00 UTC tonight. will coordinate rollback plan if this recurs.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created: scheduler soft-gate for ap-southeast1-b -> rollout 5m window.
ops-bot: runbook note: if conntrack > 90% again, add temporary taint + alert on evict-rate > 3/min.
sam lee: opening infra ticket INFR-8322 with logs, sysctl deltas, and mitigation steps. tagging @pri and @alex for follow-up. will attach a short playbook for on-call to follow.
priya n.: thanks — can we add a perf test that simulates high-FIN workloads to catch this in preprod?
alex g.: yes — I'll add a small harness that spawns many short connections through the logging sidecar and run it in staging.
sam lee: good. follow-ups: (1) scheduler gate to lower packing on that rack (alex), (2) infra change to bump conntrack defaults cluster-wide (ops), (3) firmware rollout (maria).
maria ops: noted. I'll post postmortem if anything changes after the scheduled fw roll.
sam lee: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
